description: Quote price and availability for buying ENERGY or BANDWIDTH for a receiver address before placing an order. Returns `{ unitPrice (SUN/unit), durationSec, estimateTrx (total cost in SUN), availableResource, systemDepositAddress }` — map them to `tronsave_create_order` as `orderUnitPrice`, `orderDurationSec`, `paymentPaymentAmount`. Defaults: ENERGY, 100000 units (1000 for BANDWIDTH), 900 s. Read-only and safe to call repeatedly; no session is required, but backend rate limits apply. For order-book depth use `tronsave_list_order_books`; for the minimum unit price only use `tronsave_get_min_price`.

allowPartialFill.description: Allow partial fill of the order.

buyResourceAmount.description: Resource units to buy. Default 100000 for ENERGY and 1000 for BANDWIDTH.

durationSec.description: Delegation duration in seconds. Default 900 (15 minutes).

minResourceDelegateRequiredAmount.description: Minimum resource amount per matching provider.

receiver.description: TRON address that will receive the resource. Strongly recommended: quotes depend on it.

resourceType.description: Resource type to buy. Default ENERGY.

unitPrice.description: Desired unit price in SUN. Values below the market minimum are raised to the minimum. Omit for the MEDIUM market price.

name: tronsave_estimate_buy_resource

anyOf.description: Resource units currently available at this price; if lower than requested, the order may fill partially.

availableResource.description: Resource units currently available at this price; if lower than requested, the order may fill partially.

anyOf.description: Estimated total cost in SUN (despite the name; TRX = value / 1e6) → `paymentPaymentAmount`.

estimateTrx.description: Estimated total cost in SUN (despite the name; TRX = value / 1e6) → `paymentPaymentAmount`.

anyOf.description: TronSave deposit address; destination of the signed TRX transfer for `paymentMethod=onchain`.

systemDepositAddress.description: TronSave deposit address; destination of the signed TRX transfer for `paymentMethod=onchain`.

anyOf.description: Quoted unit price in SUN per resource unit → `orderUnitPrice`.

unitPrice.description: Quoted unit price in SUN per resource unit → `orderUnitPrice`.
